selection.structured_sources: Use matching-version TeX (tex-mcp), article HTML or JATS directly where available. HTML/PDF equivalence is not certified automatically.
selection.pdf_default: Native text positions and original page rendering; no model import/download.
selection.pdf_structure: Explicit selected-page local Docling; OCR/formula recognition disabled by default.
selection.reason: Docling supplied figure/caption, formula-region, heading and page/bbox records in the tested samples. This is a workflow choice, not a comprehensive accuracy ranking.

environment.runtime_benchmark_caveat: Versions, models, devices, network, source pages and process lifetime affect all measurements; these are small sample observations, not general throughput claims.

notes: First runs included lazy model preparation/downloads after imports. They do not separately measure download versus model load.
Warm runs reused the same converter in the same process; new MCP parser workers additionally pay initialization cost.

The initial Marker output_format config did not select JSONRenderer; the JSON rerun used the explicit renderer. It confirmed Caption/Text/SectionHeader/PageFooter records but no Figure record on the tested Attention page.
MinerU was not benchmarked anew; its high quality and first-use cost were user-reported. No speed or accuracy superiority over MinerU is claimed.

scan_ocr.sample: synthetic scanned page, no text layer

formula_recognition.issue: Default formula crop expansion introduced unrelated content into the recognized LaTeX.
formula_recognition.change: Set expansion_factor=0 and disable code recognition in the formula pass; the observed unrelated matrix tail disappeared.
formula_recognition.remaining_limit: Every recognized formula remains unverified and requires checking its original crop; no claim of exact source recovery.

runs.scope: Fixed arXiv HTML/PDF, Attention figure/caption/cache/crop, ResNet formula region, scanned OCR, recognized formulas with original crop verification
Actual Docling table detection; known row/column counts and six boundary cells checked
Rechecked fixed arXiv HTML/PDF with explicit retrieval and readability of its actual referenced image assets

live_network_and_prepared_models.model_execution: Local prepared models; normal parse disallows network and paid inference APIs

tests.protocol: All 17 tool schemas and full workflows; real stdio subprocess; parse_id/profile/cache and selected-page mismatch exercised.
tests.package: Extracted wheel loaded independently; all 17 tools registered; open/read/render passed.
tests.lint_and_format: ruff check and format checks passed
tests.last_input_guard: Oversized PDF geometry rejected before structure worker rasterization; covered by offline regression.

sources.jats: Synthetic JATS fixtures tested; no claim that arbitrary PMC/publisher version matching was independently verified.

limitations: PDF figure/reference relations are not guaranteed complete; source HTML/JATS links are handled directly.
Model reading order, formulas, table cells and source conversions require verification for important claims.
Offline parser workers deny Python network connections and disable remote inference; model preparation is a separate explicit opt-in.
Proxy mode delegates name resolution and destination network policy to the configured trusted proxy; direct mode pins checked public IPs.
Prepared test environments/model cache reside under /private/tmp; this is not a promise of preinstalled models on other machines.
Model cache identity tracks revision/configuration hashes and weight file metadata; it does not cryptographically reread every model weight on every call.
